source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Use the [checklist.xlsx](https://github.com/hshaffie/uk-building-fire-safety-non-compliance/blob/master/checklist.xlsx) sheet to tick off and add any missing findings from inspection records. Repeat for each non-compliant building.
3. The inspection record should include all of the following:
  * **building name/postcode**
  * **council** (if available)
  * **date inspection done** (not date of publication of inspection record)
  * **date of publication**
  * date of publication is the date that the report was made public, this may be different from the date inspection was done
  * if date of report available please enter this as well because it will likely be different from publication date
  * (optional) date(s) at which cladding / ACM was inspected; this may be different from the date the report
